newsitem.title: USA: Thiokol Corp sees Q4 EPS about $1.25.
newsitem.headline: Thiokol Corp sees Q4 EPS about $1.25.

text.p: Thiokol Corp said Monday that it expects fourth quarter earnings per share to be about $1.25.
In April, concurrent with the release of third quarter earnings, the company said it had provided forward looking guidance for fourth quarter earnings of $1.10 to $1.15 per share.
Final year end results are scheduled for release on August 6, the company said.

James Wilson, chairman and chief executive officer said, "Performance at our Huck fastener operations and Howmet Corporation casting affiliate continue to be outstanding, especially in the commercial aircraft market. Based on preliminary results, we will exceed our prior guidance for the fourth quarter and post record earnings for the year."
